candidates.question: You have a die in a casino, but another player is its boss. May you sprawl that casino during your own turn?
candidates.required_answer: No. Only the boss may sprawl a casino; merely owning a die is insufficient.
candidates.source: Original p3 Action–Sprawl; unified physicalp10 Sprawl.
candidates.novelty_claim: Sprawl boss eligibility is given in Q10, and Q31 gives that failed control prevents sprawl before asking trade consequences. Those givens do not directly ask this source-defined eligibility branch.

candidates.question: May you use Build on an empty unowned lot or another player’s marked lot, or must the target be a lot you own?
candidates.required_answer: Build may be used only on a lot you own. An unowned lot or another player’s marked lot is not a legal Build target.
candidates.source: Original p3 Action–Build; unified physicalp10 Build.
candidates.novelty_claim: Q09 supplies your marked lot and asks cost/marker/die/tile handling. It does not directly ask ownership eligibility; this separately tests that core Build condition, distinct from Sprawl’s opposite unowned-target condition.
